paragraphs: Chapter 690
Episode 176. Destiny for Two (4)
One year in Drakka's headquarters, one year in the Tower of Stories.

During the two years of confinement, clan leaders including Kelliark often personally persuaded Hedo, and except for the formality of confinement, Hedo received treatment close to that of a distinguished guest.
It was because Kelliark treated Hedo that way.
He wanted to make Hedo a person of Zephyr as much as possible without using mind manipulation.
No matter how much mind manipulation advanced in the future, he believed that Hedo's value would decrease the moment it was added.
Of course, Hedo did not respond to Kelliark's sincerity.
In fact, Kelliark even once unlocked Hedo's shackles so he could go outside. He even promised not to retaliate as long as Hedo didn't join the Runecendel, but Hedo did not leave.
"You're given freedom, yet you refuse even that."
From Kelliark's point of view, he could not understand what had caused Hedo to despair to that extent.
Moreover, he did not know that the outside world was a hell that Hedo could neither understand nor blend into.
Rather, Hedo was perfectly adapted to the meaningless days he spent locked in the prison. Until then, there was no better state in his life.

"...It's regrettable. Since you've refused even this, you'll be transferred to the experimental ward now. But even there, if your mind changes at any time, request to the person in charge. Say you want to talk to me."
That's how Hedo was transferred to 'Experimental Ward 12', which was located near the Sota desert and the Tower of Baekya.
The overall manager of Experimental Ward 12 at the time was a person named 'Ibeon Sil', who had a notorious reputation among the test subjects for torturing under the guise of experimentation.

"Hey. It seems like the God of Inse spared you while you were in Drakka and the Tower of Stories, but here, I am God. Unless he descends here himself, that is. Hmm... I'm a bit worried about how to treat you. Whether to crush you according to your nature, or to be moderate considering the clan."
These were the first words Ibeon said when he saw Hedo. Not that Hedo was listening to his words.

"The latter would be better. After all, he's an experimental subject who's caught the eye of the God of Inse, so it'd be a bit much to treat him too roughly. Let's start with something kind and old-fashioned, like a beating."
From that day, Ibeon began to beat Hedo every day.
Normally, a common criminal, especially a non-warrior wizard's beatings couldn't hurt a superhuman.

However, Hedo at that time wasn't in his Black Sea physique due to long-term refusal to feed. He looked as if he was a weak giant, and his status was not much different from a well-trained ordinary warrior due to the shackles that restrained his power.
Hedo never resisted.
He did not scream either. He could feel the pain, but there was no need to show signs of suffering.
"Number 118! You're used to pain, aren't you? Let's see if your mouth opens today."

This time, he was typically insane. He regarded Hedo's lack of reaction as rebellion, and as he focused on the discomfort that originated from there, he began to forget the fact that Hedo was an experimental subject sent by Kelleryak.
That is to say, he began to cross the line he had tried to protect. The intensified torture and fasting by this time quickly incapacitated Hedo.

Just a while ago, he was a strong body that mercilessly tore apart the monsters of the Black Sea, defeated challengers who came in search of Chiron, and stood side by side with his Black Knights, but it was completely finished.
His limbs did not move, twisted like a withered tree, and the organs that produced aura suffered permanent damage and could not function.
Eventually, the fact that Hedo was alive became a state that could only be barely recognized by the grunt coming up on his hardened tongue, regardless of his will.
Laughably, when the situation reached that point, this time he showed a fearful look.
"This crazy... what did I do! Are you saying it's really irreparable?"
"I'm sorry, this time sir. Without Numerus's divine water, it's impossible for 118 to regenerate. Moreover, if it goes on like this, he will die soon. We have to report to the upper level...."
"Report? Report? Who the hell is this guy trying to fool? It's not 118 that's dying, it's you. How dare you.... From now on, you are the 145th experimental subject."
"This time sir? No, don't!"

This time, he took action to prevent Hedo's condition from being reported to the upper echelons. He demoted those who knew about the torture to experimental subjects, and he tried his best to keep Hedo from dying.
But, as it was, there was no improvement in the condition of a character who originally had no will to live and had brought him to that state.
If a supervisor comes from the upper level before long, it's only a matter of time before the situation becomes known. This time, he spent every day anxiously and was lost in thought.

'I received only one special instruction when I first took over 118. If 118 wants to see the master, grant his request. He didn't end up doing so, so isn't it okay if he dies? Reporting it as death during an experiment wouldn't be a problem.... Damn, there's no way. The master himself will punish me.'
It's impossible to prevent Hedo's death.

In the end, after a lot of thought, this time he chose the method of shifting the responsibility to another person in the experiment room. That is, the only experimental subject he could not deal with recklessly in the experimental room.
'I'll have to say that 109, Sandra Zipple, killed him.'
109, the experimental subject number given to Sandra.

At that time, there was no one in the 12th experiment room who called Sandra by the number. Although she was an experimental subject, she was a pure-blood Zipple, and all the researchers in the experiment room called her "Miss" and treated her like a boss.
Of course, there was hatred and ridicule behind such consideration. She was just a pure-blooded Zipple and they couldn't treat her recklessly, she was like an annoying pet in the lab.
She kept messing around in the experimental room without any restrictions, and they couldn't abuse her like other experimental subjects.
That was the 109th at the time, Sandra Zipple.
"Ibeon! They said they found me. Did a new snack come in?"
"Oh, miss. Have you arrived?"
"Is there a snack!"
"Haha, of course, a new snack has come in. Have you heard of sugar?"
"Sugar?"
"It's a powder that tastes very sweet when you eat it. Here... Ah, if you just scoop it up like that... It's a crude behavior."
"Sweet! What's crude?"
"Well, you don't need to know. And a new toy is ready too."
"Toys too? Is it my birthday today?"
"Every day is your birthday, miss. However, there is something to watch out for."
"What is it?"
"You must not kill it like the toy I gave you last time. That means you shouldn't strangle it because it doesn't listen to you, or stab it with something."
Since Sandra had already partially undergone bio-golemization, she possessed an incredible amount of power that was hard to believe for a five-year-old.
She had killed a few experimental subjects with that power, but it was more due to the pranks of Ibeon and the researchers rather than her own will.
Try poking it, Miss, Yes, if it's not very obedient, you do it like that, Sandra followed such words without any hesitation.
Although her nature was unique, the 12th experimental room was her entire world. Since the formation of her ego, she had only seen, heard, and learned from the experimental room.
Ibeon wanted to take advantage of Sandra's frog-like personality. The mischievousness of young children who do what they are told not to do and do not do what they are told seemed to be helpful.
"Remember, miss. Never, never hit or kill. Just adore and love."
"Love? What's that. Speak in a way I can understand, don't speak like an idiot!"
"......Well. Stroke its head, share stories...... even if you're annoyed, be patient. Something like that. Now, the toy must be waiting. Let's go."
That was the first meeting of Hedo and Sandra.
"Hello, number 118?"
Of course, Hedo did not respond, and Sandra ended up beating Hedo from the first day.
So, Ibeon felt that his choice was excellent, but the problem was that Hedo did not die despite her frequent assaults.
Rather, Hedo even began to regain a little strength.

Even so, he couldn't move his body, he only groaned, and occasionally spit out completed words or phrases, but the expectations of those who said he could never recover without the Numurus' holy water were wrong.
"Hey, are you dead or alive? If you're dead, be dead, if you're alive, answer. I always try to play with you."
"Go...away."
"Ugh, I'm angry! Tear your mouth and twist your neck... No, I'll endure it. Because I have to love! But get hit twice. No, three times! Oops, did you die? You're still breathing. See you tomorrow!"
Such grotesque days were continuing. The longer the time went, the more anxious Ibeon became.
'It feels like 109 is teasing me every day, on the brink of death from being beaten. 118 is too tenacious than I thought...'
When that thought crossed his mind, Ibeon locked Sandra and Hedo in the isolation cell 118. He planned to open it only after Sandra, stressed by confinement, had killed Hedo.
'Now, 109 will really finish off 118. If that happens, it won't be properly investigated by the superiors.'
"...I've never heard such a terrible story in my life, jailer."
Jin wanted to ask. How could he remain loyal to Zipple until recently after going through such things?
But remembering that the object of his loyalty was not Zipple but Sandra Zipple, he refrained from speaking.
"Everyone has a nightmare period. Even now, miss doesn't know that those days were a nightmare. Maybe... if time had continued as it was, as Ibeon intended, Miss would have eventually killed me."
Since Hedo is here now, obviously Ibeon's plan failed.
Not long after he and Sandra were isolated together, the 12th Experimental Hall was attacked by Runcandel.
"The Black Leopard, your mother, attacked the 12th Experimental Hall."
"Rosa did?"
The day she attacked, the 12th Experimental Hall was completely destroyed.
All data was discarded, and the researchers and wizards remaining in the experimental hall couldn't even hold out against her until reinforcements from the main force arrived.
At that time, when the entire experimental hall was vibrating as if it would collapse at any moment.
Sandra screamed, holding the fallen Hedo.
"She said not to worry because she will protect you."
I will protect you.

That was the first story Hedo heard since he was born. In his past life, going through the orphanage, the Black Sea, the underground dungeon, and the experimental hall, he had never heard such a thing. Because his life was not ordinary.
He didn't know what or how he would protect, but Hedo suddenly wanted to live.
He decided to live the rest of his life for this strange girl.
That day, Hedo took his first step into humanity from a beastly life.
